mapper.sql: EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_principal_role_assignment assignment JOIN auth_role_capability role_capability ON role_capability.role_id = assignment.role_id JOIN auth_capability capability ON capability.capability_id = role_capability.capability_id AND capability.capability_code = #{capability} JOIN auth_data_scope data_scope ON data_scope.scope_id = assignment.data_scope_id WHERE assignment.principal_id = #{principalId} AND assignment.valid_from <= #{at} AND (assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR assignment.valid_to > #{at}) AND data_scope.valid_from <= #{at} AND (data_scope.valid_to IS NULL OR data_scope.valid_to > #{at}) AND data_scope.scope_type = 'COMPANY' AND data_scope.company_id = batch.company_id )

batch.punch_import_batch_id AS batch_id, batch.company_id, batch.attendance_source_id AS source_id, file.original_filename, file.content_sha256 AS file_sha256, COALESCE(( SELECT state.to_state FROM punch_import_state_event state WHERE state.punch_import_batch_id = batch.punch_import_batch_id ORDER BY state.sequence_number DESC, state.punch_import_state_event_id DESC LIMIT 1 ), 'DRAFT') AS state, COALESCE(precheck.total_count, 0) AS total_rows, COALESCE(precheck.valid_count, 0) AS valid_rows, COALESCE(precheck.blocking_count, 0) AS invalid_rows, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT exact_issue.punch_import_row_id) FROM punch_import_issue exact_issue JOIN punch_import_normalization_attempt exact_attempt ON exact_attempt.punch_import_normalization_attempt_id = exact_issue.punch_import_normalization_attempt_id WHERE exact_attempt.punch_import_batch_id = batch.punch_import_batch_id AND exact_issue.issue_code = 'EXACT_DUPLICATE' ) AS exact_duplicate_rows, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT near_issue.punch_import_row_id) FROM punch_import_issue near_issue JOIN punch_import_normalization_attempt near_attempt ON near_attempt.punch_import_normalization_attempt_id = near_issue.punch_import_normalization_attempt_id WHERE near_attempt.punch_import_batch_id = batch.punch_import_batch_id AND near_issue.issue_code = 'NEAR_DUPLICATE_PENDING' ) AS near_duplicate_rows, COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(precheck.affected_subjects_json), 0) AS affected_employees, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS affected_date_from, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS affected_date_to, CASE WHEN precheck.precheck_token_digest IS NOT NULL AND precheck.expires_at > #{at} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS precheck_token_present, NULL AS precheck_token, batch.created_at, batch.row_version

JOIN punch_import_file file ON file.punch_import_batch_id = batch.punch_import_batch_id LEFT JOIN punch_import_precheck precheck ON precheck.punch_import_precheck_id = ( SELECT candidate.punch_import_precheck_id FROM punch_import_precheck candidate WHERE candidate.punch_import_batch_id = batch.punch_import_batch_id ORDER BY candidate.created_at DESC, candidate.punch_import_precheck_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM punch_import_batch batch WHERE

SELECT FROM punch_import_batch batch
WHERE ORDER BY batch.created_at DESC, batch.punch_import_batch_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT FROM punch_import_batch batch
WHERE batch.punch_import_batch_id = #{batchId} AND
mapper.sql: attempt.attempt_number = ( SELECT MAX(candidate.attempt_number) FROM punch_import_normalization_attempt candidate WHERE candidate.punch_import_batch_id = batch.punch_import_batch_id )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM punch_import_batch batch JOIN punch_import_normalization_attempt attempt ON attempt.punch_import_batch_id = batch.punch_import_batch_id AND JOIN punch_import_issue issue ON issue.punch_import_normalization_attempt_id = attempt.punch_import_normalization_attempt_id WHERE batch.punch_import_batch_id = #{batchId} AND

SELECT issue.punch_import_issue_id AS issue_id, COALESCE(row.row_number, 0) AS row_number, issue.field_name AS field, issue.issue_code AS code, issue.severity, issue.safe_message FROM punch_import_batch batch JOIN punch_import_normalization_attempt attempt ON attempt.punch_import_batch_id = batch.punch_import_batch_id AND JOIN punch_import_issue issue ON issue.punch_import_normalization_attempt_id = attempt.punch_import_normalization_attempt_id LEFT JOIN punch_import_row row ON row.punch_import_row_id = issue.punch_import_row_id WHERE batch.punch_import_batch_id = #{batchId} AND ORDER BY row.row_number, issue.severity, issue.punch_import_issue_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM punch_import_batch batch JOIN punch_import_row row ON row.punch_import_batch_id = batch.punch_import_batch_id WHERE batch.punch_import_batch_id = #{batchId} AND

SELECT row.punch_import_row_id AS row_id, row.row_number, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( row.raw_values_json, '$.employeeNumber')) AS employee_number, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( row.raw_values_json, '$.punchTime')) AS punch_time, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( row.raw_values_json, '$.sourceTimeZone')) AS source_time_zone, COALESCE(match_decision.match_status, 'UNMATCHED') AS match_state, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM punch_import_issue duplicate_issue WHERE duplicate_issue.punch_import_row_id = row.punch_import_row_id AND duplicate_issue.issue_code = 'NEAR_DUPLICATE_PENDING' ) THEN 'NEAR_PENDING' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM punch_import_issue duplicate_issue WHERE duplicate_issue.punch_import_row_id = row.punch_import_row_id AND duplicate_issue.issue_code = 'EXACT_DUPLICATE' ) THEN 'EXACT' ELSE 'NONE' END AS duplicate_state, CASE WHEN row.blocking_issue_count = 0 AND match_decision.match_status = 'MATCHED' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS publishable FROM punch_import_batch batch JOIN punch_import_row row ON row.punch_import_batch_id = batch.punch_import_batch_id LEFT JOIN employee_match_decision match_decision ON match_decision.employee_match_decision_id = row.employee_match_decision_id WHERE batch.punch_import_batch_id = #{batchId} AND ORDER BY row.row_number, row.punch_import_row_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
